title: Philippines’ biggest HiFi exhibit set this weekend
summary: Admission is free for all audio and music lovers, and there's no need to pre-register

blocks.text: Admission is free for all audio and music lovers, and there's no need to pre-register
(This is a press release from the November HiFi Show organizers.)
A team of Filipino audio experts is holding a HiFi show this weekend in Makati City.
The November HiFi Show is the Philippines’ biggest hi-fi exhibition, the country’s premier gathering for music lovers and audio enthusiasts that has been around for 24 years.
Each year, it brings together leading and local international brands showcasing the finest in high-fidelity and high-quality sound systems, speakers, amplifiers, turntables, and more.

Beyond the gear, it’s also a treasure trove for collectors, with rare finds, vinyl records, and CDs waiting to be discovered. More than just an exhibition, the November HiFi Show is a celebration of sound culture — where innovation, passion, and community converge.

“Since 2008, my team of Filipino audio experts and I have been doing this purely for the love of the hobby—no commercial agenda, just a shared mission to build world-class, 100% Filipino-made DIY high-end audio gear,” said veteran business journalist and Rappler columnist Val Villanueva.
The November HiFi Show 2026 will be held on November 28 to 29 at the Makati Diamond Residences, 118 Legazpi Street, Legazpi Village, Makati City.
Parking can be found nearby Greenbelt Malls, and street side parking is available in Legazpi Village.
Admission is free for all audio and music lovers, and there’s no need to pre-register. Just walk in and enjoy what the November HiFi Show has to offer.
Whether you’re a seasoned audiophile or just curious about great sound, swing by Room 802. Let’s talk gear, swap stories, and enjoy the music. – Rappler.com
